runs.measured_quantity: Process duration of failed launch/initialization, not render wall time
Process duration of failed launch/initialization, not render wall time

failure.diagnosis: The native wrapper still rejected index 32. Its ordered delivery priorities started at 96; index 32 would overflow the signed 8-bit Event::Priority. Both attempts exited inside m5.instantiate(), before m5.simulate().

post_attempt_fix.description: Widen Event::Priority to signed 16 bits and extend its extrema, then accept native wrapper indices 0-63 with a compile-time assertion that all 64 delivery priorities fit after the quantum barrier.
validation: Targeted gem5_wrapper.o and msi.o builds passed.
async_eventq.test.opt: all 8 tests passed, including 64 delivery priorities above the quantum barrier with no wraparound.
post_attempt_fix.required_next_step: Obtain approval for additional simulator attempts, rebuild gem5.opt, and capture a fresh two-run pair.

process_wall_definition: Launch, initialization, boot, rendering, statistics dumps, image export and shutdown; excludes artifact archiving, validation and report generation.
measurement_notes: Exactly one fresh untraced attempt per queue mode, sequentially; no automatic retries, extra protocol runs or host-renderer runs.
Full simulator rebuilt with signed 16-bit event priorities and indices 0-63 before either fresh attempt. Firmware build targets checked up to date.
Source, binary, shared-library and firmware hashes checked unchanged after both runs.
No competing gem5 processes before, during or after either fresh attempt. No build, tests or profiling overlapped timing.
Unrestricted affinity over 20 logical CPUs; 65 event queues/threads are oversubscribed. Default quantum barrier spin budget retained, with no environment override.

In response to a user progress query during PDES, a brief static symbol/layout lookup and two read-only process-memory snapshots were performed. No debugger attach, process pause, signals, tracing or statistics changes.
Image/configuration/traffic validation and comparison of all simulated counters took place after both timing runs.
One sample per mode does not establish timing variance or isolate the slowdown cause.

progress_monitoring.method: Read-only /proc/PID/mem snapshots; no attach, pause, signals, debugger or statistics changes
progress_monitoring.layout: mainEventQueue dynamic symbol; _curTick offset 48 verified from sim/eventq.o DWARF
